scientific_review.density: Broad positive features cover both quinone headgroups; reviewed ester sites and A914 water-site feature remain visible. Strong density and nearly planar quinone rings do not validate the long deposited carbonyl bonds. Mg axial geometry requires a separate qualified interpretation.
scientific_review.preparation: PSI-14 ACPI; related 9L0K is another study assembly rather than an independent replicate. Primary model-building source is 8WM6.

description: Diatom PSI monomer associated with five FCPI subunits. Core-pocket comparisons retain the PsaA/PsaB alignment frame rather than aligning the peripheral antenna.
notes: Primary study identifies five FCPI subunits associated with one PSI core from strain CCMP1335. Native assembly and antenna architecture are not inferred from the cropped contact scenes.
The deposited initial-model category records an experimental model with source Other but no accession. An explicit starting PDB accession is not assigned from that category.

Primary model-building Methods use ModelAngelo, postprocessed and Topaz-denoised maps, followed by refinement including protein-cofactor coordination restraints. This is source-study processing, not processing performed by this atlas.
